query:
SELECT 
  o.id, o.customerName, o.customerEmail, o.customerPhone,
  o.status, o.amount, o.paidAt, o.createdAt,
  o.accessTokenId, o.xenditInvoiceId,
  t.token, t.used, t.expiresAt
FROM aptitudeProOrders o
LEFT JOIN aptitudeAccessTokens t ON o.accessTokenId = t.id
ORDER BY o.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
